rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.quote: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.summary: It is illegal for anyone to sell or provide algorithmic rent-setting software to landlords, and it is illegal for landlords to use such software to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental properties.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to all residential rental property in the City of San Diego
rules.exemption_note: Does not include software that publishes reports using aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or public information without recommending rental rates; or software used to establish rental rates in accordance with affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: Tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation. Each month a violation exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, constitutes a separate and distinct violation. Prevailing tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
